question: Should this PR land the additive SessionEntry byte-compaction retry metadata and 1 MiB/10% hysteresis as the supported behavior for repeated byte-triggered preflight compaction?
rationale: The code path and proof look sound, but the change intentionally persists new session-state metadata and changes when an existing byte-threshold configuration will retry compaction.

options.title: Accept retry hysteresis
options.body: Land the PR if maintainers agree that preventing every-turn byte compaction loops is worth delaying same-transcript byte retries until material growth.

options.title: Tune retry policy first
options.body: Change the growth constants or matching conditions before merge if owners want a different retry window or stricter upgrade semantics.

options.title: Pause for broader compaction policy
options.body: Hold this PR if owners want to resolve the adjacent auto-compaction semantics and status-accounting discussion first.

recommendation.title: Accept retry hysteresis
recommendation.body: Land the PR if maintainers agree that preventing every-turn byte compaction loops is worth delaying same-transcript byte retries until material growth.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shallow history points to recent ownership of all touched source files, and this is a cross-cutting session-state merge-risk decision.
